title: HubSpot Marketing Hub - Unified marketing automation platform for SMB to enterprise
clean_text: HubSpot Marketing Hub consolidates email marketing, social media management, landing pages, lead capture, and campaign tracking into a single platform built on top of HubSpot's customer data hub, replacing scattered point solutions. It serves customers across more than 135 countries, with HubSpot targeting 9,000-10,000 net new customers per quarter in 2026. The platform has evolved from a traditional marketing/CRM tool into an AI-assisted revenue platform under HubSpot's 2026 "agentic customer platform" direction, adding AI-driven personalization and workflow automation across the funnel.

meta.target: SMB to enterprise marketing teams, global (135+ countries)
meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, seat and contact-volume based
